#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
# tools/prepush-check.sh with a stub quickcheck.sh: a push to integration of the box repository with the same
# update hook as tools/update.hook does not run the check here ("quick check: server runs it"). All other cases run it.
set -u
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_COMMON_DIR GIT_PREFIX GIT_QUARANTINE_PATH GIT_NAMESPACE
unset X0X_QC_CLIENT X0X_BOX_REPO   # the test sets them per case
D="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
T=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ppt.XXXXXX"); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$T/g" && cp "$D/tools/prepush-check.sh" "$T/g/" && chmod 755 "$T/g/prepush-check.sh"
printf '#!/bin/sh\necho run >> "%s/qc.calls"\necho "QUICK PASS stub"\n' "$T" > "$T/g/quickcheck.sh"; chmod 755 "$T/g/quickcheck.sh"
G="git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t -c init.defaultBranch=main"
$G init -q "$T/c" && mkdir -p "$T/c/tools" && echo 'echo hook v1' > "$T/c/tools/update.hook" && echo a > "$T/c/a" && \
    $G -C "$T/c" add -A && $G -C "$T/c" commit -qm one || { echo "FAIL setup"; exit 1; }
S=$(git -C "$T/c" rev-parse HEAD); Z=0000000000000000000000000000000000000000
git init -q --bare "$T/box.git" && git init -q --bare "$T/other.git"
hooks() {  # update-content|none pre-receive(1/0)
    rm -f "$T/box.git/hooks/update" "$T/box.git/hooks/pre-receive"
    [ "$1" = none ] || { printf '%s\n' "$1" > "$T/box.git/hooks/update"; chmod 755 "$T/box.git/hooks/update"; }
    [ "$2" = 1 ] && { echo 'exit 0' > "$T/box.git/hooks/pre-receive"; chmod 755 "$T/box.git/hooks/pre-receive"; }; :; }
fails=0
chk() {  # name expect(skip|run|none) url [ref] [env...]
    n=$1; e=$2; u=$3; r=${4:-refs/heads/integration}; if [ $# -ge 4 ]; then shift 4; else shift $#; fi
    rm -f "$T/qc.calls"
    out=$(cd "$T/c" && echo "refs/heads/main $S $r $Z" | env GIT_DIR="$T/c/.git" GIT_WORK_TREE="$T/c" X0X_BOX_REPO="$T/box.git" "$@" \
        bash "$T/g/prepush-check.sh" origin "$u" 2>&1); rc=$?
    got=none; [ -f "$T/qc.calls" ] && got=run
    echo "$out" | grep -q 'quick check: server runs it' && got=skip
    [ "$got" = skip ] && ! echo "$out" | grep -q "QUICK PASS ${S%"${S#???????}"}" && got=skip-no-pass
    if [ "$got" = "$e" ] && [ $rc = 0 ]; then echo "ok   $n: $got"; else echo "FAIL $n: want $e, got $got (rc=$rc): $out"; fails=$((fails + 1)); fi
}
hooks 'echo hook v1' 1
chk "box, same update hook"            skip "$T/box.git"
chk "box as file:// URL"               skip "file://$T/box.git"
chk "box, X0X_QC_CLIENT=1"             run  "$T/box.git" refs/heads/integration X0X_QC_CLIENT=1
chk "other repository"                 run  "$T/other.git"
chk "box, not integration"             none "$T/box.git" refs/heads/lane/x
hooks 'echo hook v2' 1
chk "box, other update hook sha"       run  "$T/box.git"
hooks none 1
chk "box, no update hook"              run  "$T/box.git"
hooks 'echo hook v1' 0
chk "box, no pre-receive hook"         run  "$T/box.git"
hooks 'echo hook v1' 1; chmod 644 "$T/box.git/hooks/update"
chk "box, update hook not executable"  run  "$T/box.git"
echo "prepush trim: $fails FAIL"
[ "$fails" = 0 ]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Guard: engine_brk_loops must not mute the break while rewriting loops (#354).

Chicago land f701ae34 reintroduced brk_hold around engine_brk_loops and dropped
breaks_flush. Any audio ISR between hold=1 and hold=0 skips break render for a
whole buffer — audible dropout when changing loops. Owner: gap must be gone.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import pathlib
import re
import sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ENGINE = ROOT / "firmware/src/app/engine.c"


def fail(msg: str) -> None:
    print(f"FAIL: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(1)


def main() -> None:
    text = ENGINE.read_text()
    if re.search(r"\bbrk_hold\b", text):
        fail("engine.c still has brk_hold — mute around loop rewrite is back")

    m = re.search(
        r"X0X_COLD\s+void\s+engine_brk_loops\s*\(\s*void\s*\)\s*\{(.*?)^\}",
        text,
        re.S | re.M,
    )
    if not m:
        fail("engine_brk_loops not found")
    body = m.group(1)
    if "breaks_flush" not in body:
        fail("engine_brk_loops must call breaks_flush so deferred bank publish lands on device")
    if re.search(r"brk_hold\s*=\s*1", body):
        fail("engine_brk_loops must not arm brk_hold")

    # Step / live / render paths must not gate on a hold flag.
    if re.search(r"if\s*\(\s*brk_hold\s*\)", text):
        fail("s_brk (or similar) still early-returns on brk_hold")
    if re.search(r"C_BRK\s*&&\s*!brk_hold", text):
        fail("C_BRK live path still gated on !brk_hold")
    if re.search(r"if\s*\(\s*!brk_hold\b", text):
        fail("render/mix still gated on !brk_hold")

    print("PASS: engine_brk_loops seamless (no brk_hold; breaks_flush present)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Render a 303 note crossing a page and a pattern loop, then check edge cues."""

import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

from PIL import Image


root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
binary = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else root / "build/host/x0x_host")
out = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else root / "build/roll-continuation")
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
subprocess.run([str(binary), str(root / "tests/scenarios/roll_continuation.x0x"), str(out)], check=True)


def green(name, x, y):
    rgb = Image.open(out / name).convert("RGB").getpixel((x, y))
    return rgb[1] > rgb[0] + 30 and rgb[1] > rgb[2] + 30


for stem in ("page", "loop"):
    assert not green(f"roll_{stem}_out.png", 237, 102), f"{stem}: premature right cue"
    assert green(f"roll_{stem}_out_connected.png", 237, 102), f"{stem}: missing right cue"
    assert green(f"roll_{stem}_in.png", 21, 102), f"{stem}: missing left cue"

short = out / "short"
short.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
subprocess.run([str(binary), str(root / "tests/scenarios/roll_short_tie.x0x"), str(short)], check=True)
short_image = Image.open(short / "fractional_tie.png").convert("RGB")
assert short_image.getpixel((53, 102))[1] > 70, "short tied endpoint has no brick"
assert short_image.getpixel((56, 102))[1] < 70, "connector overdraws short tied endpoint"

print("roll continuation display: page and loop cues PASS")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Regression: never reuse generated font bytes across changed renderer inputs.

Run with: python3 tests/gen_cache_renderer_closure_test.py
The baseline without renderer runtime in its cache key must fail the Pillow test.
This tests the real gen_cache fingerprint/store/restore paths without vendor SDK.
"""
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from PIL import features
import PIL

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
import gen_cache  # noqa: E402


def check_runtime_inputs():
    rendered = gen_cache._font_renderer_inputs()
    assert rendered["pillow"] == PIL.__version__
    assert rendered["freetype2"] == (features.version_module("freetype2") or "unavailable")
    assert rendered["raqm-enabled"] == ("1" if features.check("raqm") else "0")
    assert rendered["raqm-version"] == (
        (features.version_feature("raqm") or "unavailable") if features.check("raqm") else "disabled"
    )


def tests():
    # Fixed simulated compiler/source/asset closure isolates only Pillow and its
    # rendering features, so different key hashes prove explicit invalidation.
    with patch.dict(os.environ, {"CC": "cc"}, clear=True), \
         patch.object(gen_cache, "_sources", return_value=[]), \
         patch.object(gen_cache, "_font_files", return_value=[]), \
         patch.object(gen_cache, "_wavs", return_value=[]), \
         patch.object(gen_cache.shutil, "which", return_value="/usr/bin/cc"), \
         patch.object(gen_cache.subprocess, "run", return_value=subprocess.CompletedProcess(
             ["cc", "--version"], 0, stdout="cc-test 1\n", stderr="")):
        first = gen_cache.fingerprint()
        assert first == gen_cache.fingerprint(), "identical closure must reuse key"
        with patch.object(PIL, "__version__", "9.4.0"):
            old = gen_cache.fingerprint()
        with patch.object(PIL, "__version__", "12.3.0"):
            new = gen_cache.fingerprint()
        assert old != new, "Pillow upgrade must invalidate generated headers"

        with patch.object(features, "version_module", return_value="2.12.0"):
            old_ft = gen_cache.fingerprint()
        with patch.object(features, "version_module", return_value="2.14.3"):
            new_ft = gen_cache.fingerprint()
        assert old_ft != new_ft, "FreeType change must invalidate font glyph cache"

        with patch.object(features, "check", return_value=False):
            no_raqm = gen_cache.fingerprint()
        with patch.object(features, "check", return_value=True):
            has_raqm = gen_cache.fingerprint()
        assert no_raqm != has_raqm, "raqm/no-raqm digit layout may differ"

        with patch.object(features, "check", return_value=True), \
             patch.object(features, "version_feature", return_value="0.9.0"):
            raqm_v1 = gen_cache.fingerprint()
        with patch.object(features, "check", return_value=True), \
             patch.object(features, "version_feature", return_value="0.10.5"):
            raqm_v2 = gen_cache.fingerprint()
        assert raqm_v1 != raqm_v2, "raqm implementation update must invalidate glyphs"

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="x0x-gen-cache-closure-") as tmp:
            os.environ["X0X_GEN_CACHE"] = str(Path(tmp) / "cache")
            dest = Path(tmp) / "gen"
            dest.mkdir()
            original = {}
            for name in gen_cache.HEADERS:
                data = (name + " original bytes\n").encode()
                (dest / name).write_bytes(data)
                original[name] = data
            baseline = gen_cache.fingerprint()
            gen_cache.store(dest)
            for name in gen_cache.HEADERS:
                (dest / name).unlink()
            with patch.object(PIL, "__version__", "99.0.0"):
                assert not gen_cache.restore(dest), "stale version must be cache miss"
                assert not any(dest.iterdir()), "a miss cannot restore stale files"
            assert gen_cache.restore(dest), "matching runtime must restore cached headers"
            assert all((dest / n).read_bytes() == data for n, data in original.items())
            # Truncated/tampered entry must fail despite unchanged key.
            entry = Path(os.environ["X0X_GEN_CACHE"]) / baseline
            (entry / gen_cache.HEADERS[0]).write_bytes(b"corrupt")
            assert not gen_cache.restore(dest), "corrupted entry must never be accepted"
            del os.environ["X0X_GEN_CACHE"]

        with patch.dict(sys.modules, {"PIL": None}):
            try:
                gen_cache._font_renderer_inputs()
            except OSError:
                pass
            else:
                raise AssertionError("unavailable renderer metadata must fail closed")
    print("PASS: Pillow/FreeType/raqm closure changes miss, match restores, corruption rejected")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    check_runtime_inputs()
    tests()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
# Deterministic, read-only web and sample-safety checks. No firmware build,
# USB/MIDI device access, package publication, or source mutation.
set -euo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.."
mkdir -p build/bugfinder
run_dir="$(mktemp -d build/bugfinder/run.XXXXXXXX)"
mkdir -p "$run_dir/logs"
summary="$run_dir/summary.md"
passed=0
failed=0
source_commit="$(git rev-parse --verify HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"

printf '## LoopyX0X37 local smoke checks\n\n' > "$summary"
printf 'Checked Git source: `%s`\n\n' "$source_commit" >> "$summary"
printf '| Check | Result |\n| --- | --- |\n' >> "$summary"

check() {
  local name="$1"; shift
  local logfile="$run_dir/logs/${name}.log"
  if "$@" > "$logfile" 2>&1; then
    passed=$((passed + 1))
    printf '| `%s` | PASS |\n' "$name" >> "$summary"
    printf 'PASS %s\n' "$name"
  else
    local code=$?
    failed=$((failed + 1))
    printf '| `%s` | FAIL (exit %s) |\n' "$name" "$code" >> "$summary"
    printf 'FAIL %s (exit %s)\n' "$name" "$code"
    tail -n 15 "$logfile" || true
  fi
}

check js-breaks-syntax node --check web/x0x_breaks.js
check js-projects-syntax node --check web/x0x_projects.js
check breaks-web node web/test_breaks.mjs
check projects-web node web/test_projects.mjs
check projects-page node web/test_projects_page.mjs
check slot-backup python3 tests/x0x_slots_test.py
check installer-slots python3 tests/install_slots_test.py

printf '\nResults: %s passed; %s failed. Host checks only, no firmware or hardware PASS.\n' "$passed" "$failed" >> "$summary"
if [[ -n "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY:-}" ]]; then
  cat "$summary" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
fi
printf 'Summary and logs: %s\n' "$run_dir"
printf 'Check summary: %s passed; %s failed\n' "$passed" "$failed"
if (( failed > 0 )); then
  exit 1
fi
